behaviours.name: Fel Monstrosity (Stamina)
behaviours.quote: Increases your Stamina by $s1%
behaviours.observe_source: 500067 Effect[0] aura 137 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE, MiscValue 2 (Stamina), BasePoints 19 + 1 = 20 ($s1). The caster's exact Stamina (Player::GetExactStatValue, unrounded) is read before and after a real learn of 500067 (the reading before is the control without it): reference stat 2 = 79 (class file) x 1.20 = 94.8, ratio judged within 0.002 so +19% (93.99) and +21% (95.6) are excluded. Bless 804247 is the harmless self cast in both phases. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 500067: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event; positive control 801904 Azzinoth's Assault: 21 casts); the bindmysoul snapshot is an older state (it says Stamina 25%; the DBC tooltip says 20% and prevails); expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only.

behaviours.expected_source: 560645 Effect[1] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, BasePoints 19 + 1 = 20 ($s2). The main-hand strike 520262 of Azzinoth's Assault 801904 (Effect[0] trigger 520262, Effect[1] trigger 572585) is cast by a real cast; its non-critical hits are averaged in a control arm without 560645 and a treatment arm with it learned: ratio 1.20 within the 2-point band. Non-critical hits only (the critical filter), so no crit fixture is needed. Fixtures by harness set_aura, named as preconditions: Felfury 800058 x6 and At Least 2 Felfury 803468 on the caster before each cast (Azzinoth's Assault 801904 needs 803468 and consumes 2 Felfury; AscensionFelsworn.cpp:219-228), in both arms and phases. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 560645 and 560646: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event; positive control 801904 Azzinoth's Assault: 21 casts); the bindmysoul snapshot says Assault damage +10% where the DBC tooltip and Effect[1] say 20% (an older state, the tooltip prevails, G-9) and repeats the 20% haste for 5 seconds.
